body:
## Approved Implementation Plan

### Sub-tasks

| # | Description | Complexity | Dependencies |
|---|------------|------------|-------------|
| 1 | Define `JobManifest` model structs + `merge_run` method | Standard | None |
| 2 | Add manifest methods to `LogStore` trait + `FsLogStore` impl | Complex | 1 |
| 3 | Call `update_manifest` after run completion in executor | Light | 2 |
| 4 | Unit tests for aggregation, bucketing, serialization | Standard | 1 |
| 5 | Integration tests for FsLogStore manifest operations | Standard | 1, 2 |

### Execution Order
- Phase 1: Sub-task 1
- Phase 2 (parallel): Sub-tasks 2, 4
- Phase 3 (parallel): Sub-tasks 3, 5

### Key Design Decisions
- Per-model: Use `run.model` as single model key per run (pragmatic, matches current data fidelity)
- Cleanup ordering: `update_manifest` called BEFORE `cleanup` at convergence point
- Weekly/monthly buckets: Independently maintained in `merge_run`
- Windows atomic write: Remove target before rename
- Executor: Single `update_manifest` call at convergence point, not per-branch

🤖 Plan auto-approved (autonomous nightly run)
